G1_S1C1.title: First Steps
G1_S1C1.goal: Type 'forward(150)' to move the turtle to the yellow circle.
G1_S1C1.learningObjective: Tell the computer to move the turtle.

G1_S1C2.title: A Simple Turn
G1_S1C2.goal: Type 'turn(90)' to face up. Then type 'forward(150)'.

G1_S1C3.title: Corner Turn
G1_S1C3.learningObjective: Move and turn in one go.

G1_S1C4.title: Two Sides
G1_S1C4.goal: Draw two lines. Forward 100, Turn 90, Forward 100.
G1_S1C4.learningObjective: Follow a path with two steps.

G1_S1C5.title: Three Sides
G1_S1C5.goal: Almost a square! Forward, Turn, Forward, Turn, Forward.

G1_S1C6.title: Make a Square
G1_S1C6.goal: Draw all 4 sides of a square. Each side is 100 long.

G1_S1C7.title: Staircase Steps
G1_S1C7.goal: Climb the stairs! Forward, Turn Left, Forward, Turn Right...

G2_S1C1.title: Red and Blue
G2_S1C1.goal: Use 'penColor("red")', draw a line. Then 'penColor("blue")', draw another.

G2_S1C2.title: Jump Over
G2_S1C2.goal: Draw a line, 'penUp()', move, 'penDown()', draw again.
G2_S1C2.learningObjective: Lift the pen to jump gaps.

G2_S1C3.title: Dashed Line
G2_S1C3.goal: Draw a line with gaps. Draw, Jump, Draw, Jump.

G2_S1C4.title: Intro to Loops
G2_S1C4.goal:
Draw a long line by repeating 'forward(50)' 4 times.
Use:
repeat 4 {
  forward(50)
}
G2_S1C4.learningObjective: Use a loop to repeat commands.

G2_S1C5.title: Square Loop
G2_S1C5.goal:
Draw a square using a loop.
Use:
repeat 4 {
  forward(100)
  turn(90)
}
G2_S1C5.learningObjective: Draw a shape efficiently with a loop.

G2_S1C6.title: Colorful Line
G2_S1C6.goal: Use a loop to draw a line, changing color each time.

G2_S1C7.title: Double Loop
G2_S1C7.goal: Put a loop inside a loop! Try drawing 4 small squares.

G3_S1C1.title: Function for a Square
G3_S1C1.goal: Define and use a function to draw a square. (Note: Functions not yet implemented)
G3_S1C1.learningObjective: Learn to create functions to reuse code.

G3_S1C2.title: Function with a Size Parameter
G3_S1C2.goal: Create a function that can draw squares of any size.
G3_S1C2.learningObjective: Learn to use parameters to make functions more powerful.

G3_S1C3.title: Function to Draw a House
G3_S1C3.goal: Combine a square and a triangle function to draw a house.
G3_S1C3.learningObjective: Learn to compose functions to create more complex drawings.

G4_S1C1.title: Variable for Length
G4_S1C1.goal: Use a variable to control the length of a line. (Note: Variables not yet implemented)
G4_S1C1.learningObjective: Learn to declare and use variables to store values.

G4_S1C2.title: Growing Spiral
G4_S1C2.goal: Use a variable that changes in a loop to draw a spiral.
G4_S1C2.learningObjective: Learn how to modify variables within a loop.

G4_S1C3.title: Math with Variables
G4_S1C3.goal: Draw a half-square using a variable and division.
G4_S1C3.learningObjective: Learn to perform simple arithmetic operations on variables.

G5_S1C1.title: Conditional Color
G5_S1C1.goal: Draw a line that changes color halfway. (Note: Conditionals not yet implemented)
G5_S1C1.learningObjective: Learn to use 'if' statements to control program flow.

G5_S1C2.title: Wall Bounce
G5_S1C2.goal: Make the turtle turn around when it hits a 'wall'.

G5_S1C3.title: If/Else Branching
G5_S1C3.goal: Draw a shape with alternating colors using an if/else statement.
G5_S1C3.learningObjective: Learn to use if/else statements for branching logic.
